svg.title: EP2 C3 AREA 19
svg.desc: In CCA, fight gatekeepers only. Complete every marked fixed pickup and split-route mechanism. Use the source-numbered rooms as the route order; colored symbols identify switches, barriers, warps and fixed pickups.
